svg.text: The A pulley sits high with its teeth on top; the B pulley sits

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: low with its hub on top. If both look the same, one is wrong —

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and no amount of Ch 07 belt tension will fix it. Both use the

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20T 6 mm pulley; the four 9 mm 20T pulleys are the Z drive's.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A/B identity is from the LDO wiring guide and the LDO Klipper config (## A Stepper - Right / ## B Stepper - Left) — the official manual never states it. Motors are 0.9°, LDO-42STH48-2004MAH(VRN).
